Retro Cartoon Graffiti EDM Party Poster for "TALIEU & FRIENDS" This design features a playful DJ narrative with a striking color palette of green, pink, and white. 1. Visual Focus The core visual centers on a cartoon green crocodile DJ, rendered with a green background and pink line-art graffiti texture. The main scene depicts two crocodiles operating a DJ deck, accented with musical notes to emphasize the relaxed and witty atmosphere of the party. 2. Information Elements The details are organized with a clear hierarchy: the title "TALIEU & FRIENDS" stands out in bold white text. It also lists the date "20TH SEPTEMBER 2025 1PM-10PM", the lineup (Archie Briant), and the venue "93 FEET EAST 150 BRICK LANE, LONDON, E1 6QL". 3. Color & Texture Dominated by a green base, pink graffiti outlines, and white typography, the design overlays cartoon figures and DJ elements to recreate the retro, playful texture of 90s underground EDM party posters. It perfectly blends the humor of the cartoon crocodiles, the dynamic energy of electronic music elements, and the visual tension of the contrasting colors—capturing both the carnival spirit of the party and the laid-back vibe of retro graffiti.

Style: retro cartoon graffiti poster. The image is a single event-poster design with a dark green, grainy, distressed background, hot-pink spray-paint outlines, white block typography, and black ink-style cartoon crocodiles. Across the upper portion, oversized white brush lettering reads "TALIEU", with rough dry-brush edges and a hand-painted street-art feel. Beneath it, a large hot-pink ampersand reads "&", followed by another large white brush-lettered word, "FRIENDS", completing the title "TALIEU & FRIENDS". Pink paint splatters, drips, and underline strokes surround the headline, while small pink musical-note icons float around the composition. On the left side below the title, the date and time appear in stacked white uppercase text as "20TH SEPTEMBER 2025" and "1PM-10PM". Below that, a smaller white label reads "LINEUP:", followed by the performer name "ARCHIE BRIANT" in larger white uppercase letters. Near the lower-left area, the venue information appears in bold white uppercase text as "93 FEET EAST" and "150 BRICK LANE, LONDON, E1 6QL". In the central-right foreground, two anthropomorphic crocodile DJs occupy the main illustration. The larger crocodile sits behind a DJ setup, wearing oversized black headphones with green accents and a dark jacket or hoodie. Its green scaly skin has darker spots, black outlines, expressive eyes, and a slightly open mouth showing small teeth. One hand rests near the turntable while the other reaches toward the mixer controls. The second crocodile appears to the right, also wearing headphones and leaning over the equipment with an excited, open-mouthed expression. The DJ deck includes turntables, tonearms, knobs, sliders, cables, and small glowing pink indicator lights, all drawn in a gritty comic-graffiti style. Behind the characters, a neon-pink outline drawing of a boombox spans the mid-right background, with cassette details, speakers, buttons, and dripping paint effects. Additional pink graffiti marks, curved strokes, splashes, and music symbols fill the surrounding space, reinforcing the underground EDM party atmosphere. The overall palette is dominated by deep green, hot pink, white, and black, with high contrast, rough textures, and a playful 1990s underground poster aesthetic.

上传图片，说清楚你想改什么就行。需要保留的地方可以特别说明，其他细节由 AI 帮你补充。

【通用写法】
把图里的【对象】改成【想要的样子】，保留【不想改变的部分】。

【多图参考】
用图1的【人物／产品】，参考图2的【服装／场景／画风】，做成【想要的画面】。

【常见用法】

1. 服装换色
把人物的白色上衣改成深红色，其他不变。

2. 整套换装
让图1的人穿上图2的衣服，脸和姿势不变。

3. 更换背景
把背景换成海边日落，保留人物。

4. 更换发色
把头发改成银白色，发型不变。

5. 更换表情
让人物笑得开心一点，其他不变。

6. 更换光线
改成温暖的夕阳光，人物和场景不变。

7. 白天变夜晚
把白天改成夜晚，让街边的灯亮起来。

8. 更换天气
改成下雪天，屋顶和地面有一点积雪。

9. 添加道具
给人物右手加一杯咖啡。

10. 移除道具
去掉桌上的花瓶，其他不变。

11. 移除路人
去掉人物后面的路人，保留主角。

12. 抠出主体
把这只猫抠出来，背景透明。

13. 添加文字
在图片上方加上“夏日特惠”，用醒目的白色大字。

14. 替换文字
把“夏日特惠”改成“限时优惠”，位置和样式不变。

15. 产品换色
把这辆车改成黑色，款式和标志不变。

16. 产品换背景
把这瓶香水放在大理石台面上，背景简洁一点。

17. 扩图
把图片左右扩宽成横图，保留原来的内容。

18. 局部修改
把圈出来的椅子换成木椅，其他不变。

19. 保持姿态换场景
让这个人保持现在的姿势，站到雪山前。

20. 多人物合影
让图1和图2的人站在一起，在公园里合影。

21. 转换画风
把图1画成图2的漫画风格，保留人物特征。

22. 制作多宫格
用图里的人物做九宫格漫画，讲他们打游戏输了后吵起来的故事。
